papers.title: RangeAugment: Efficient Online Augmentation with Range Learning
alternate_titles: RangeAugment: Efficient Online Augmentation with Range Learning
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art automatic augmentation methods (e.g., AutoAugment and RandAugment) for visual recognition tasks diversify training data using a large set of augmentation operations. The range of magnitudes of many augmentation operations (e.g., brightness and contrast) is continuous.
